tools.name: leverage_run
tools.description: Start a Leverage mission. Describe the outcome and the policy; Leverage compiles a task graph, hires models against it, verifies every result and replaces workers that fail. Returns immediately with a mission id — poll leverage_status for progress.

goal.description: What must be true when this is done. Plain language.

budgetMaxUsd.description: Hard ceiling on paid inference in USD. 0 means paid routes are blocked entirely, not merely discouraged. Defaults to 0.

qualityTarget.description: Minimum verified quality to accept a task, 0-1. Defaults to 0.95.

privacy.description: local-only never sends task content to a cloud model.

tools.name: leverage_status
tools.description: Current state of a mission: task states, hired workers, handoffs, spend and elapsed time. Safe to poll.

tools.name: leverage_cancel
tools.description: Stop a mission. No further workers are hired; in-flight work is checkpointed where possible.

tools.name: leverage_proof
tools.description: The evidence for a mission: every check that ran, what it returned, files changed, quality breakdown and actual spend. This is what makes a completed mission checkable rather than merely claimed.

tools.name: leverage_models
tools.description: The workforce Leverage can currently reach, with each model cost class, health and its measured track record. Success rates are shrunk toward a prior and carry a sample count.
